_doc: Encargo de ilustraciones para Nano Banana (tools/arte/nanobanana.py). 'estilo' se antepone a cada prompt; 'referencias' son imágenes de estilo que se mandan con cada pieza. Cada grupo genera sus piezas en 'salida'. Añadir una pieza = añadir una entrada; las que ya existen en disco no se regeneran salvo --forzar.
estilo: Gritty hand-inked comic illustration for a dark-humour fantasy football management game. Same art style as the reference image: thick irregular black ink linework, heavy cross-hatching in the shadows, three-tone cel shading, muted earthy palette, slightly grimy textured paper look, expressive and ugly-charming faces. Bust portrait, three-quarter view, head and shoulders, the character looks fierce and battered. Square format, the character fills the frame, the background is a painted cloth in the colour given that fills the whole square edge to edge, no empty paper margin. No text, no letters, no logo, no frame border.

grupos._doc: Láminas de referencia para el modelado 3D (frente, perfil, espalda) de cada raza, en el mismo estilo. Se usan para modelar o elegir modelos, no en el juego.
grupos.estilo_extra: Character model sheet: the same character shown full body three times side by side — front view, side view, back view — standing in a neutral pose, plain parchment background, wearing a blue football tunic with gold trim. Proportions: big head and hands, chunky, stylised.
